title: c12-close-the-pass
universal_lens: The C12 protocol formalizes a constrained boundary-value problem on a high-dimensional state manifold. It enforces strict epistemic closure by resolving residual unverified degrees of freedom (blockers) and projecting abstract planning manifolds into concrete, executable artifacts, ensuring the system transitions from theoretical equilibrium to operational reality.
gsi_mapping: C12 acts as a conformal post-processing layer in GSI. It treats C11's unverified items as high-uncertainty priors, applying rigorous empirical verification (shell commands) to collapse probability distributions. The resulting explicit decisions update the posterior risk metrics, guaranteeing the predictive model remains calibrated against live system telemetry.
gse_mapping: In GSE, C12 represents a critical situational state-transition operator. It evaluates the current tactical board (C11 output), identifies unresolved blockers preventing a 'paid-launch' victory condition, and executes precise micro-actions (feature flag toggles, artifact generation) to force the game state into a deployable configuration.

reasoning_traces.think:
The C12 protocol operates as a rigorous mathematical reduction of an open-ended engineering audit into a closed, deterministic execution sequence. By explicitly forbidding the re-derivation of the ten-dimension inventory (Quote 3), the system establishes a fixed prior state, $S_{c11}$, treating it as an immutable boundary condition. The core operator, Epistemic Closure (Quote 5), functions by isolating the subspace of unverified variables—specifically the seven unanswered questions and five paid-launch blockers—and applying targeted transformations to resolve them. This prevents combinatorial explosion and focuses computational resources on the exact failure points identified in the previous iteration.

Crucially, the protocol introduces a dual-mode evaluation metric based on runtime capabilities (Quotes 12-14). The Runtime Provenance Kernel distinguishes between executed truths (`[RUN]`) and inferred hypotheses (`[INFERRED]`). As highlighted in the excerpts, a correctly tagged but mathematically invalid derivation demonstrates that provenance tagging alone is insufficient; the underlying method must be sound. Therefore, C12 demands exact shell commands and file pointers, effectively requiring a constructive proof for every claim rather than a purely semantic assertion.

Finally, the Context Invariant Handoff (Quote 10) ensures the solution is robust against temporal decay and cognitive load. By demanding artifacts actionable at '2am with no context', the system enforces maximum entropy compression of the decision logic. The resulting state transition moves the project from a probabilistic, high-risk development phase into a deterministic, deployable configuration, satisfying the strict constraints of the launch window.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive lineage traces back to von Neumann’s work on self-reproducing automata and modern DevOps chaos engineering. It inherits the rigor of formal verification methods used in aerospace, adapted for agile software deployment. reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The primary actor is modeled as a highly constrained, parallelized expert panel operating under severe token limits and potential runtime isolation. The opposing agent is entropy—the natural tendency of complex systems to accumulate unverified assumptions and technical debt. C12 anticipates the actor's fatigue ('2am') and the environment's hostility (truncated outputs, invalid statistical methods), proactively building defensive structures like explicit revert switches and dated shipping decisions to neutralize these threats.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict veto is applied against any output that relies solely on `[INFERRED]` tags for critical path dependencies. If a statistical claim uses an invalid method (like inverting a permutation p-value through the normal CDF), it is immediately discarded regardless of its provenance tag. Furthermore, any attempt to re-run the full C11 inventory is vetoed to prevent resource exhaustion. The system mandates that a retraction or recomputation must itself be treated as a verifiable claim, preventing silent corruption of the truth baseline.
